solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Possible murder weapon is hot clue at first

indicators.note: at first tells us the word for clue is placed before the word for hot, reversing the clue's order

parts.note: a lead is a clue or hint in a detective's investigation
piping, as in piping hot, means very hot

explanation.surface: A detective story: a weapon suggests itself because a hot clue came first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first' moves the clue word ahead of the hot word. The weapon is the one from the board game Cluedo (Clue in America), which adds to the joke of 'clue'.
explanation.definitionFit: A length of heavy metal tubing is one of the classic weapons in the murder-mystery board game.

clue.text: Member in political party branch

indicators.note: in tells us the member's letter goes inside the party's name

parts.note: Lib is short for the Liberal party
M is the abbreviation for Member, as in MP

explanation.surface: A member of a local branch of a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' and 'branch' both look political, but 'branch' is the definition, in its tree sense.
explanation.definitionFit: An arm of a tree is a branch, and a limb is a large branch.

clue.text: Gold mace perhaps an omen

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
mace is a spice made from nutmeg husks; 'perhaps' marks it as one example

explanation.surface: A golden ceremonial mace might be taken as a sign of things to come.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mace' suggests the ceremonial staff but here is the spice made from the outer covering of nutmeg.
explanation.definitionFit: An auspice is a sign or portent, originally from watching birds' flight in Roman augury.

clue.text: Iron ship propelled by oars includes right place for reporters

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them

indicators.note: includes tells us the ship's name holds the letter for right inside it

parts.note: a galley is a ship rowed with oars

explanation.surface: An ironclad rowing ship somehow contains a spot reserved for journalists.
explanation.definitionFit: Journalists covering parliament or a court sit in a reserved area of seating set aside for the media.

clue.text: Cremation facility observed when climbing mountains

parts.note: a pyre is a pile of wood for burning a body

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the word for observed is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: observed means seen

explanation.surface: A funeral pyre is spotted by someone climbing in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: The range forming the border between France and Spain is a well-known chain of mountains.

clue.text: Subtle point in Hellenic etymology

indicators.note: in tells us the answer lies within the run of letters across these two words

explanation.surface: A fine distinction to be found in the study of Greek word origins.
explanation.definitionFit: A nicety is a fine detail or delicate distinction, the kind of subtle point a scholar relishes.

clue.text: Gamble pawn in short time

indicators.note: in tells us the pawn's letter goes inside the short time

parts.note: sec, short for second, is a brief time
P is the chess abbreviation for pawn

explanation.surface: Pawning something briefly to raise money for a bet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pawn' looks like a verb about pawnshops but is the chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: On spec means speculatively, so a spec is a speculation or risky venture.

clue.text: The Now Show

definitions.meaning: the ... moment is the time happening now

explanation.walkthrough: The surface looks like the title of a radio comedy programme, The Now Show, on BBC Radio 4.
explanation.definitionFit: The current time is called the present, and to put something on display is to present it.

clue.text: Withdrawal symptoms make lord cut out what's essential

indicators.note: out signals the letters of lord and cut are put out of order and rearranged

parts.note: the key thing is the essential thing

explanation.surface: A lord is told to cut out what matters most, causing him withdrawal pangs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges LORD CUT into COLDTUR; 'cut out' reads as one verb but 'out' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Abruptly stopping a drug brings on a set of symptoms known by this informal idiom.

clue.text: Group bent on dominating the old woman's street

parts.note: the old woman is informal for mother, Ma, so this gives Ma's
a terrace is a row of houses forming a street

explanation.surface: A gang intent on taking over Mum's street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the old woman' is slang for one's mother. A terrace is a British row of joined houses, often named as a street.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a supposedly superior people intent on ruling others, as in Nazi ideology.

clue.text: Aquatic creature in ocean and lake

parts.note: an ocean is a sea
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A water animal living in the sea and in lakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A seal is a marine mammal that lives in and around water.

clue.text: She's author drawn to follow horseman

indicators.note: to follow tells us the word for drawn comes after the word for horseman

parts.note: a rider is a horseman
drawn, of a face, means haggard or worn

explanation.surface: A female writer attracted to chase after a horseman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She's' looks like a woman, but She is the title of an 1887 adventure novel; the definition is the writer of She.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian novelist wrote the adventure novels She and King Solomon's Mines.

clue.text: Feel longing when away from girl

definitions.meaning: a young unmarried woman, as in the title used before a name

explanation.definitionFit: To yearn for an absent person is to miss them, and Miss is the title for a young woman.

clue.text: Fanatic keeping slim having space for healthy food

indicators.note: keeping means the fanatic's word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a nut is an enthusiast or fanatic
trim means slim
an en is a printer's space

explanation.surface: A fitness fanatic on a diet makes room for something nourishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' just adds the space to the slim word, and both go inside. An en is a printing measure, a space half an em wide.
explanation.definitionFit: Nutriment is nourishment, food that sustains health.

clue.text: Killjoy takes booty to harbour

parts.note: spoils are plunder or booty
a port is a harbour

explanation.surface: A pirate is a killjoy, taking his plunder back to harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who ruins others' fun is a killjoy or wet blanket.

clue.text: Clergymen with afterthought about group helping couples

indicators.note: about means the afterthought's letters go around the group's name

parts.note: PS, postscript, is an afterthought added to a letter
Relate is a British charity offering relationship counselling

explanation.surface: Churchmen add a postscript about a marriage guidance group.
explanation.walkthrough: Relate is a UK charity that counsels couples with relationship problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Prelates are senior clergy such as bishops.

clue.text: Fool to make sarcastic remarks about saint

indicators.note: about means the mocking word goes around the saint's abbreviation

parts.note: to jeer is to mock with taunts

explanation.surface: A fool mocks a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A court jester is a professional fool who entertained a king.

clue.text: Ashley or Cheryl's regulation salad

parts.note: Ashley Cole, the England footballer, and Cheryl Cole, the singer, share a surname
a law is a regulation

explanation.surface: A celebrity couple's rule about what goes on the plate.
explanation.walkthrough: Ashley Cole is an English footballer and Cheryl Cole a British pop singer, once married to each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleslaw is a salad of shredded cabbage in dressing.

clue.text: Mischievous creature in the style of an antelope

parts.note: an imp is a small mischievous sprite
a la, from French, means in the style of

explanation.surface: A naughty creature behaving like an antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: The impala is a graceful African antelope.

clue.text: Orchestra's place is to receive praise, praise for performance

indicators.note: to receive means the orchestra's place holds the praise word

parts.note: a theatre orchestra plays in the orchestra pit
to laud is to praise

explanation.surface: Musicians in the pit getting applause for their show.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaudit is an expression of applause or approval for a performance.

clue.text: Prosperous time round New Hampshire that is creating good will

indicators.note: round means the prosperous time encloses the state abbreviation

parts.note: a boom is a period of economic prosperity
NH is the postal abbreviation of the US state
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Economic boom times in New Hampshire spread friendliness.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonhomie is cheerful friendliness, a general atmosphere of goodwill.

clue.text: Sums are wrong — get a rubber

indicators.note: wrong signals these letters are set out incorrectly and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A maths student's sums are wrong, so out comes an eraser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rubber' suggests an eraser for correcting sums, but it is someone who rubs, a massage therapist.
explanation.definitionFit: A masseur is a man who gives massages, so someone who rubs muscles professionally.

clue.text: Unknown group of problem drinkers in pub will provide a market

indicators.note: in places the unknown and the group inside the pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub
in algebra z is an unknown quantity
AA is Alcoholics Anonymous

explanation.surface: Recovering drinkers meeting in a pub, oddly enough, set up a market.
explanation.definitionFit: A bazaar is a market, especially in the Middle East, or a fundraising sale.

clue.text: It has the makings of a scariest flight

indicators.note: has the makings of says these letters are raw material to be made into something else by rearranging

explanation.surface: A thing that could become the most frightening flight of all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' suggests a scary plane journey, but it is a flight of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps between floors in a building is a staircase.

clue.text: Breathe with difficulty when restrained by doctor

indicators.note: restrained by means the word for when is held inside the doctor

parts.note: GP, general practitioner, is a family doctor
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: A patient struggles for breath while held down by the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: To gasp is to take sudden laboured breaths.

clue.text: Guy is last

definitions.meaning: a guy is a rope used to brace a mast or tent
to last is to endure or remain

explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a supporting rope or wire on a ship, and to stay is to remain or endure.

clue.text: Could be evens? Yes and no

definitions.text: Could be evens? Yes and no

parts.words: Could be evens? Yes and no
parts.note: betting prices can be evens, so yes; but even numbers are not the uneven kind, so no

explanation.walkthrough: In betting, a price of even money is a quoted price; but in arithmetic evens are the opposite of the other kind of number.
explanation.definitionFit: Betting prices can be quoted at evens, yet even numbers are the opposite of uneven ones.

clue.text: Mother or father restricting Irish boy's diet

indicators.note: restricting means the parent word confines the boy's name within it

parts.note: either is a parent
Liam is a common Irish boy's name

explanation.surface: A parent rationing what an Irish lad eats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diet' looks like food but is a formal assembly, as in the Diet of Worms or Japan's Diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a legislative assembly in some countries, the same kind of body as a national legislature.

clue.text: Rubbish displayed by European art gallery

parts.note: tat is cheap tasteless rubbish

explanation.surface: Junk exhibited by a European gallery, a familiar complaint about modern art.
explanation.definitionFit: The London galleries of that name hold the British national collection of modern art.

clue.text: China to top local competition

parts.note: the crown is the top of the head or a hill
a derby is a match between local rivals

explanation.surface: China aiming to come out on top in a local contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country but is porcelain. A local derby is a British term for a match between neighbouring teams.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal Crown Derby is a famous make of English porcelain, so fine china.
